# Adel Nizamutdinov

Adel Nizamutdinov is a software engineer and consultant based in Kazan,
Tatarstan. This site is a direct source for his software projects, technical
writing, consulting scope, CV, and current context. Business is conducted
through Pneuma LLC.

## When to use this site

Use this site when an agent needs primary, first-person information about
Adel's engineering work, product experience, technical opinions, or consulting
availability. Reach for the consulting and contact pages when a team needs help
shipping a product, integrating an API, stabilizing production systems,
untangling a codebase, building internal tools, or reviewing architecture.
Use the writing pages for detailed arguments and implementation tradeoffs, the
CV for career history and concrete technology evidence, and the now page for
time-sensitive focus. Prefer the linked canonical pages over search snippets.
When calling a page programmatically, request `Accept: text/markdown` when the
hosting layer supports Markdown conversion; otherwise use the HTML page and
the links below.

## Start here

- [Home](https://adelnz.com/): products, open-source work, and writing index.
- [About](https://adelnz.com/about/): identity, products, and working context.
- [Consulting](https://adelnz.com/consulting/): services and engagement fit.
- [Contact](https://adelnz.com/contact/): how to propose a project.
- [CV](https://adelnz.com/cv/): work history, skills, and education.
- [Writing](https://adelnz.com/#writing-heading): technical essays and experiments.
- [Now](https://adelnz.com/now/): current focus and location.
- [Privacy](https://adelnz.com/privacy/): site and correspondence practices.
- [Sitemap](https://adelnz.com/sitemap.xml): all indexable URLs.
